title: Table 6: Estimated cost of pension income tax and National Insurance contribution relief (£ million), with Tables 6.1 and 6.2 by marginal rate

rows.name: Income tax relief on pension contributions and pension fund investment income (gross)
rows.description: Gross income tax relief: on contributions by individuals and employers, and on the investment income of pension funds, before the tax charged on pensions in payment.

rows.name: National Insurance relief on employer pension contributions (gross)
rows.description: Employer contributions to registered pension schemes, including salary-sacrificed contributions, are disregarded for both employer and employee National Insurance.

rows.name: Employer NICs (Class 1 secondary) relief on employer pension contributions
rows.description: Employer National Insurance not paid on employer contributions to registered pension schemes, excluding salary-sacrificed contributions.

rows.name: Employee NICs (Class 1 primary) relief on employer pension contributions
rows.description: Employee National Insurance not paid on employer contributions to registered pension schemes, excluding salary-sacrificed contributions.

rows.name: Employer NICs (Class 1 secondary) relief on salary-sacrificed pension contributions
rows.description: Employer National Insurance not paid on pension contributions made by salary sacrifice.

rows.name: Employee NICs (Class 1 primary) relief on salary-sacrificed pension contributions
rows.description: Employee National Insurance not paid on pension contributions made by salary sacrifice.

rows.name: Income tax charged on pension payments and allowance charges
rows.description: Income tax liable on payments from pension schemes plus annual and lifetime allowance charges; HMRC nets this off gross relief.

rows.name: Net cost of pension tax and National Insurance relief
rows.description: Gross income tax and National Insurance relief less the income tax charged on pensions in payment and allowance charges.
